messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call for the Atlas team; Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team this cycle as of 2025-04-03. [decision; valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz takes the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- On 2026-02-16, team Dune noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is on the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, having taken over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team, having taken over from Oskar Lind. [decision; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is the primary on-call for the Ember team, not Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
